content.short: GPS-based Assets on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
Cardano Beam adds GPS locations to Assets on Cardano Blockchain.

Using Cardano Beam anyone can place an NFT, a Token, or ADA anywhere on the world map so that someone else can go there and pick it up. It all centers around rewarding someone for being at a certain location at a certain time.

The problem is for anyone who ever wanted to incentivize someone else to be at a certain location out of need, or out of love. A form of a location-based Nudge that could alter people’s behavior in a predictable way without forbidding any options or significantly changing their economic incentives.

The Cardano Beam protocol is made up of a Web App that businesses, governments, and others use to place assets on the world map, and a Mobile App that users have in their pocket on a mobile device and walk around collecting Assets around them. The Assets are locked in smart contracts at GPS coordinates on the world map and the users unlock them by going to the GPS location of the smart contract.

The project was funded in through Catalyst. Additional detail available on our website and on the Catalyst proposal https://cardano.ideascale.com/c/idea/396850 .
